    --argjson rerun "$RERUN_JSON" --argjson pending "$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | sed '/^$/d' | jq -R . | jq -sc .)" \
    --argjson outage "$OUTAGE_JSON" --argjson ohist "$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON" \
    '{schema_version: 1, suite: "ablation-2.0", batch: $batch, smoke: $smoke, state: $state, per_arm: $per,
      retries: $retries, cuts: $cuts, paused_arms: $paused,
      spend: {rows_usd: ($rows_usd | tonumber), ledger_usd: ($ledger | tonumber), spent_usd: ($spent | tonumber),
              max_usd: (if $max == "" then null else ($max | tonumber) end), assumed_cap_trials: $assumed},
      trials_planned: $planned, resume_cursor: $cursor, drift: $drift, drift_cleared: $cleared, rerowed: $rerowed,
      rerun: $rerun, rerun_pending: $pending, outage: $outage, outage_history: $ohist,
      extra_models: ([$ebr | to_entries[] | .value | to_entries[]] | group_by(.key)
                     | map({key: .[0].key, value: {runs: length, output_tokens: (map(.value) | add)}}) | from_entries),
      extra_models_by_run: $ebr, rows_invalid: $invalid, signalled: $signalled,
      source_commit: $src, rows_file: $rows, started: $started, finished: $finished}' > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp"
  mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
}

cleanup() {
  local f p
  for f in "$JOBS_DIR"/*.pgid; do
    [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    read -r p _ < "$f" || continue
    kill -TERM -- "-$p" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$p" 2>/dev/null || true
  done
  for p in $(jobs -p 2>/dev/null); do kill "$p" 2>/dev/null || true; done
  rm -rf "$JOBS_DIR" "$LOCK" "$WORK" 2>/dev/null || true
}
trap cleanup EXIT

# --- one trial (a background job; its result goes to $JOBS_DIR/<jid>.*) -------------
fresh_dir() { local b="$1" k=2; [[ -e "$b" ]] || { printf '%s' "$b"; return; }; while [[ -e "$b-r$k" ]]; do k=$((k + 1)); done; printf '%s' "$b-r$k"; }
final_status() {  # final_status <run-dir> → the pipeline status, empty when missing or running
  local s; s="$(jq -r '.status // ""' "$1/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || true)"
  case "$s" in completed|agent_error|cap_failure|infrastructure_error|interrupted) printf '%s' "$s" ;; *) printf '' ;; esac
}
synthesize_record() {  # synthesize_record <run-dir> <arm> <task> <type> <trial> <run_id> <reason>
  local rd="$1"
  mkdir -p "$rd/meta"
  [[ -f "$rd/meta/arm" ]] || printf '%s\n' "$2" > "$rd/meta/arm"
  if ! jq -e 'type == "object"' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    jq -n --arg r "$6" --arg a "$2" --arg t "$3" --arg ty "$4" --argjson n "$5" --arg src "$SRC_FULL" --arg why "$7" \
      --arg now "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --arg mode "$EXECUTOR" \
      '{schema_version: 1, run_id: $r, arm: $a, task_id: $t, task_type: $ty, trial: $n, source_commit: $src,
        status: "interrupted", reason: $why, cap_phase: null, spent_usd: 0, executor_mode: $mode, phases: [],
        snapshots: {}, started: $now, finished: $now, synthesized_by: "run-ablation.sh"}' > "$rd/meta/pipeline.json"
  fi
}
# post_run <run-dir> <run_id> <task> <task_yaml> <attempts> <retry_reason> <pipeline_status>
#          <override> <row-out> <log> — the chain after a finished pipeline, shared by a trial
# and by --rerow: took-effect, drift guard, grade (completed, agent_error and cap_failure runs
# without an override), then ablation-row.sh into <row-out>. Results in PR_TE (ok | fail |
# skipped), PR_TE_REASON, PR_DRIFT (json or null), PR_EXTRA (the extra models, json),
# PR_GRC (null or the grade exit), PR_RRC (the row exit) and PR_OVERRIDE (the final override)
post_run() {
  local rd="$1" rid="$2" task="$3" tyaml="$4" attempts="$5" rr="$6" st="$7" row_out="$9" plog="${10}"
  PR_OVERRIDE="$8" PR_TE=skipped PR_TE_REASON="" PR_DRIFT=null PR_EXTRA='{}' PR_GRC=null PR_RRC=0
  if [[ -z "$PR_OVERRIDE" ]]; then
    case "$st" in
      completed|agent_error|cap_failure)
        local trc=0 tout dout id
        tout="$("$TOOK_BIN" --run-dir "$rd" --suite-file "$SUITE_FILE" 2>&1)" || trc=$?
        printf '%s\n' "$tout" >> "$plog"
        if [[ $trc -eq 0 ]]; then PR_TE=ok
        else
          PR_TE=fail PR_OVERRIDE=infrastructure_error
          PR_TE_REASON="took-effect exit $trc: $(grep -E ' FAIL' <<<"$tout" | head -4 | cut -c1-200 | tr '\n' ';' || true)"
        fi
        dout="$(drift_check "$rd" "$rid" 2>>"$plog" || true)"
        PR_DRIFT="$(sed -n 1p <<<"$dout")" PR_EXTRA="$(sed -n 2p <<<"$dout")"
        jq -e . >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PR_DRIFT" || PR_DRIFT=null
        jq -e 'type == "object"' >/dev/null 2>&1 <<<"$PR_EXTRA" || PR_EXTRA='{}'
        while IFS=$'\t' read -r id labels toks; do
          [[ -n "$id" ]] || continue
          printf 'run-ablation: extra model %s in %s (%s output tokens; a WebFetch summariser or built-in subagent, not drift — DEC-0545)\n' \
            "$id" "$labels" "$toks" >> "$plog"
        done < <(jq -r 'to_entries[] | [.key, (.value.phases | join(",")), (.value.output_tokens | tostring)] | @tsv' <<<"$PR_EXTRA")
        if [[ "$PR_DRIFT" != null ]]; then PR_OVERRIDE=infrastructure_error; printf 'run-ablation: drift %s\n' "$PR_DRIFT" >> "$plog"; fi
        if [[ -z "$PR_OVERRIDE" ]]; then
          local -a g=("$GRADE_BIN" "$rd" "$task" --suite-root "$SUITE_ROOT" --executor "$EXECUTOR" --image "$IMAGE" --docker-bin "$DOCKER_BIN")
          [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && g+=(--tasks-dir smoke)
          PR_GRC=0; "${g[@]}" >> "$plog" 2>&1 || PR_GRC=$?
          if [[ $PR_GRC -ne 0 ]]; then PR_OVERRIDE=infrastructure_error; printf 'run-ablation: grade exit %s\n' "$PR_GRC" >> "$plog"; fi
        fi ;;
    esac
  fi

content.content:
fi
  local -a r=("$ROW_BIN" --run-dir "$rd" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --manifest "$MAN_PATH" --attempts "$attempts" --out "$row_out")
  [[ -n "$rr" ]] && r+=(--retry-reason "$rr")
  [[ -n "$PR_OVERRIDE" ]] && r+=(--status "$PR_OVERRIDE")
  "${r[@]}" >> "$plog" 2>&1 || PR_RRC=$?
  return 0
}

run_trial() {  # run_trial <jid> <arm> <task> <type> <kind> <trial> <run_id> <task_yaml> <watchdog_s>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" task="$3" type="$4" kind="$5" trial="$6" rid="$7" tyaml="$8" wds="$9"
  local base="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
  local attempt=0 rd="" st="" prc retry_reason="" first_usd=0 sig override="" pid
  local t0 t1
  mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
  t0="$(date +%s)"
  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    rd="$(fresh_dir "$base")"
    printf '%s\n' "$rd" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.rundir"
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wdkill"
    printf '%s run-ablation: %s attempt %d run_dir %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$attempt" "$rd" >> "$tlog"
    local -a cmd=("$PIPELINE_BIN" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --arm "$arm" --run-dir "$rd" --run-id "$rid" --trial "$trial"
                  --source-tree "$TREE" --suite-file "$SUITE_FILE" --executor "$EXECUTOR" --image "$IMAGE"
                  --docker-bin "$DOCKER_BIN" --max-run-usd "$RUN_CAP")
    # its own process group, so the watchdog can signal the pipeline and everything under it
    if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
    else "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
    fi
    pid=$!
    printf '%s %s %s\n' "$pid" "$(date +%s)" "$wds" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
    prc=0; wait "$pid" || prc=$?
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
    st="$(final_status "$rd")"
    if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" ]]; then
      override=interrupted
      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "watchdog: no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (pipeline exit $prc)"
      break
    fi
    if [[ -z "$st" ]]; then
      override=interrupted
      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "no final pipeline record (pipeline exit $prc)"
      break
    fi
    if [[ "$st" == agent_error ]] && sig="$(is_pipeline_transport_failure "$rd")"; then
      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
        first_usd="$(jq -r '(.spent_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
        retry_reason="transport: ${sig% *} in phase ${sig#* }"
        printf '%s run-ablation: %s %s; retrying once after %ss into a fresh run dir\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$retry_reason" "$RETRY_WAIT" >> "$tlog"
        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
      fi
      override=transport_error
    fi
    break
  done
  post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "$tyaml" "$attempt" "$retry_reason" "$st" "$override" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$tlog"
  t1="$(date +%s)"
  jq -n --arg rid "$rid" --arg rd "$rd" --argjson att "$attempt" --arg rr "$retry_reason" --arg first "$first_usd" \
    --arg pst "${st:-}" --arg ov "$PR_OVERRIDE" --arg te "$PR_TE" --arg ter "$PR_TE_REASON" --argjson drift "$PR_DRIFT" \
    --argjson grc "$PR_GRC" --argjson rrc "$PR_RRC" --argjson secs "$(( t1 - t0 ))" --argjson extra "$PR_EXTRA" \
    '{run_id: $rid, run_dir: $rd, attempts: $att, retry_reason: (if $rr == "" then null else $rr end),
      first_attempt_usd: ($first | tonumber? // 0), pipeline_status: $pst, override: $ov, took_effect: $te,
      took_effect_reason: $ter, drift: $drift, grade_rc: $grc, row_rc: $rrc, seconds: $secs,
      extra_models: $extra}' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp"
  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result"
}

# --- parent: collect a finished job ---------------------------------------------------
append_and_validate() {  # append_and_validate <row-file> <run_id> → 0 ok; 1 invalid (ROWS_INVALID set)
  local rowf="$1" rid="$2" vout vrc=0 n
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$ROWS"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    { flock -x 9; cat "$rowf" >> "$ROWS"; vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || vrc=$?; } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  else
    cat "$rowf" >> "$ROWS"; vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || vrc=$?
  fi
  n="$(grep -cF "\"run_id\":\"$rid\"" "$ROWS" || true)"
  if [[ $vrc -ne 0 ]]; then
    ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --arg e "$(printf '%s' "$vout" | tail -1)" '{run_id: $r, error: $e}')"; return 1
  fi
  if [[ "$n" -ne 1 ]]; then
    ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --argjson n "$n" '{run_id: $r, error: "run_id rowed \($n) times"}')"; return 1
  fi
  return 0
}

# apply_flags <arm> <run_id> <took_effect> <reason> <drift> — a took-effect FAIL pauses the
# arm (DEC-0418); the first drift stops the batch (DEC-0407)
apply_flags() {
  if [[ "$3" == fail ]] && ! is_paused "$1"; then
    PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$1" --arg why "$2: $4" '. + {($a): $why}' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
    log "PAUSED arm $1: $4 (no further trial of $1 launches until --resume --clear-arm $1)"
  fi
  if [[ "$5" != null && "$DRIFT_JSON" == null ]]; then
    DRIFT_JSON="$5"; STOP=drift
    log "DRIFT $2: $5; no further trial launches; the batch fails when the running trials end (DEC-0407)"
  fi
  return 0
}
# record_extra <run_id> <extra models json> — the run's extra models replace its earlier entry
record_extra() {
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$1" --argjson e "$2" \
    'if ($e | type) == "object" and ($e | length) > 0 then .[$r] = ($e | map_values(.output_tokens // 0)) else del(.[$r]) end' <<<"$EXTRA_RUNS_JSON")"
}

# outage_tick <run_id> <row status, empty without a row> — the breaker (DEC-0554): consecutive
# collected transport_error trials (collection order, any arm) trip it at $OUTAGE_BREAKER (0 off)
outage_tick() {
  if [[ "$2" == transport_error ]]; then OUTAGE_RUN=$((OUTAGE_RUN + 1)); else OUTAGE_RUN=0; fi
  if [[ "$OUTAGE_BREAKER" -gt 0 && $OUTAGE_RUN -ge $OUTAGE_BREAKER && "$OUTAGE_JSON" == null && -z "$STOP" ]]; then
    STOP=outage
    OUTAGE_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson n "$OUTAGE_RUN" --arg r "$1" \
      '{at: $at, consecutive: $n, last_run_id: $r,
        message: "partial (outage breaker): \($n) consecutive transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back"}')"
    log "OUTAGE breaker: $OUTAGE_RUN consecutive transport_error trials (last $1); no further trial launches (DEC-0554)"
  fi
  return 0
}

collect() {  # collect <jid> <plan-index>
  local jid="$1" k="$2" arm="${PL_ARM[$2]}" rid="${PL_RUN[$2]}" kind="${PL_KIND[$2]}" res="$JOBS_DIR/$1.result"
  if [[ ! -f "$res" ]]; then
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $rid (the trial job ended without a result; see $BATCH_DIR/$arm/${PL_TASK[$k]}-t${PL_TRIAL[$k]}.log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    outage_tick "$rid" ""
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*; write_status; return 0
  fi
  local first att rr te ter drift
  first="$(jq -r '.first_attempt_usd' "$res")" att="$(jq -r '.attempts' "$res")" rr="$(jq -r '.retry_reason // ""' "$res")"
  te="$(jq -r '.took_effect' "$res")" ter="$(jq -r '.took_effect_reason' "$res")" drift="$(jq -c '.drift' "$res")"
  record_extra "$rid" "$(jq -c '.extra_models // {}' "$res")"
  if [[ "$att" -ge 2 ]]; then
    RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg why "$rr" --arg u "$first" '. + [{run_id: $r, reason: $why, first_attempt_usd: ($u | tonumber)}]' <<<"$RETRIES_JSON")"
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$first")"; LEDGER_USD="$(fadd "$LEDGER_USD" "$first")"
  fi
  local st="" cost deg pass
  if [[ -s "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
    IFS=$'\t' read -r st cost deg pass < <(jq -r '[.status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring),
        ((.hidden_test_pass_rate // .defect_catch_rate // "n/a") | tostring)] | @tsv' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")
    if is_rerun "$rid"; then
      # DEC-0553: the new row replaces the old one in place; the old row's reported cost moves to the ledger
      if replace_row_try "$rid" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"; then
        local from ocost
        from="$(jq -r --arg r "$rid" '.[$r].status' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")" ocost="$(jq -r --arg r "$rid" '.[$r].cost' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        LEDGER_USD="$(fadd "$LEDGER_USD" "$ocost")"
        RERUN_LIST="${RERUN_LIST/$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'/$'\n'}"
        RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "$from" --arg t "$st" --arg c "$ocost" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
          '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, old_cost_usd: ($c | tonumber), at: $at}]' <<<"$RERUN_JSON")"
        log "rerun $rid: $from → $st (row replaced in place)"
      else
        ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --arg e "$REPLACE_ERR" '{run_id: $r, error: ("rerun replacement: " + $e)}')"
        log "ROWS INVALID after $rid: $(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID")"; STOP=invalid
      fi
    elif append_and_validate "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$rid"; then :; else
      log "ROWS INVALID after $rid: $(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID")"; STOP=invalid
    fi
    DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
    account_row "$arm" "$kind" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    log "done $rid $st pass=$pass USD $cost $(( $(jq -r '.seconds' "$res") / 60 ))m attempts $att${rr:+ ($rr)}"
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $rid: no row written (ablation-row.sh exit $(jq -r '.row_rc' "$res"); see the trial log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
  fi
  outage_tick "$rid" "$st"
  apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$te" "$ter" "$drift"
  rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
  write_status
}

PIDS=() PJOB=() PIDX=()
watchdog_tick() {
  local j f pid start wds now rd t0
  now="$(date +%s)"
  for j in ${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}; do
    f="$JOBS_DIR/$j.pgid"; [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    read -r pid start wds < "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
    [[ -n "$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE" ]] && wds="$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE"
    [[ $(( now - start )) -gt $wds ]] || continue
    rd="$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$j.rundir" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [[ -z "$(final_status "$rd")" ]] || continue
    if [[ ! -f "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$now" > "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd"
      log "watchdog: $j has no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (twice its phase-sum timeout); SIGTERM to process group $pid"
      kill -TERM -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    elif [[ ! -f "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wdkill" ]]; then
      read -r t0 < "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd" || t0="$now"
      if [[ $(( now - t0 )) -ge $WATCHDOG_GRACE ]]; then
        : > "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wdkill"
        log "watchdog: $j still running ${WATCHDOG_GRACE}s after SIGTERM; SIGKILL to process group $pid"
        kill -KILL -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
  done
  return 0
}
reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
  local i
  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PIDX[$i]}"
        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PIDX[i]'
        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PIDX=("${PIDX[@]+"${PIDX[@]}"}")
        break
      fi
    done
    watchdog_tick
    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep "$POLL_S"
  done
  return 0
}

on_signal() {
  SIGNALLED=true
  log "interrupted: the driver received a signal; running trials are signalled and will be rerun by --resume"
  STATE=partial; write_status
  exit 1
}

finish() {  # finish <state> <exit> <message>
  STATE="$1"; write_status; log "$3"
  local line
  line="$("$SPEND_BIN" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
  {
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "${line:-spend.sh printed nothing}"
    printf '%s batch %s spend USD %s (rows %s + first attempts %s; %s assumed cap charge(s)); max %s\n' \
      "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$BATCH" "$SPENT" "$ROWS_USD" "$LEDGER_USD" "$ASSUMED_CAP" "${MAX_USD:-none}"
  } >> "$BATCH_DIR/spend.txt"
  echo "run-ablation: $3"
  echo "batch: $BATCH_DIR"
  exit "$2"

tool_use_result.stdout:
fi
  local -a r=("$ROW_BIN" --run-dir "$rd" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --manifest "$MAN_PATH" --attempts "$attempts" --out "$row_out")
  [[ -n "$rr" ]] && r+=(--retry-reason "$rr")
  [[ -n "$PR_OVERRIDE" ]] && r+=(--status "$PR_OVERRIDE")
  "${r[@]}" >> "$plog" 2>&1 || PR_RRC=$?
  return 0
}

run_trial() {  # run_trial <jid> <arm> <task> <type> <kind> <trial> <run_id> <task_yaml> <watchdog_s>
  local jid="$1" arm="$2" task="$3" type="$4" kind="$5" trial="$6" rid="$7" tyaml="$8" wds="$9"
  local base="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
  local attempt=0 rd="" st="" prc retry_reason="" first_usd=0 sig override="" pid
  local t0 t1
  mkdir -p "$BATCH_DIR/$arm"
  t0="$(date +%s)"
  while [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; do
    attempt=$((attempt + 1))
    rd="$(fresh_dir "$base")"
    printf '%s\n' "$rd" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.rundir"
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wdkill"
    printf '%s run-ablation: %s attempt %d run_dir %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$attempt" "$rd" >> "$tlog"
    local -a cmd=("$PIPELINE_BIN" --task-yaml "$tyaml" --arm "$arm" --run-dir "$rd" --run-id "$rid" --trial "$trial"
                  --source-tree "$TREE" --suite-file "$SUITE_FILE" --executor "$EXECUTOR" --image "$IMAGE"
                  --docker-bin "$DOCKER_BIN" --max-run-usd "$RUN_CAP")
    # its own process group, so the watchdog can signal the pipeline and everything under it
    if command -v setsid >/dev/null 2>&1; then setsid "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
    else "${cmd[@]}" >> "$tlog" 2>&1 < /dev/null &
    fi
    pid=$!
    printf '%s %s %s\n' "$pid" "$(date +%s)" "$wds" > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
    prc=0; wait "$pid" || prc=$?
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.pgid"
    st="$(final_status "$rd")"
    if [[ -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.wd" ]]; then
      override=interrupted
      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "watchdog: no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (pipeline exit $prc)"
      break
    fi
    if [[ -z "$st" ]]; then
      override=interrupted
      synthesize_record "$rd" "$arm" "$task" "$type" "$trial" "$rid" "no final pipeline record (pipeline exit $prc)"
      break
    fi
    if [[ "$st" == agent_error ]] && sig="$(is_pipeline_transport_failure "$rd")"; then
      if [[ $attempt -lt 2 ]]; then
        first_usd="$(jq -r '(.spent_usd // 0) | tonumber? // 0' "$rd/meta/pipeline.json" 2>/dev/null || echo 0)"
        retry_reason="transport: ${sig% *} in phase ${sig#* }"
        printf '%s run-ablation: %s %s; retrying once after %ss into a fresh run dir\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$retry_reason" "$RETRY_WAIT" >> "$tlog"
        sleep "$RETRY_WAIT"; continue
      fi
      override=transport_error
    fi
    break
  done
  post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "$tyaml" "$attempt" "$retry_reason" "$st" "$override" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$tlog"
  t1="$(date +%s)"
  jq -n --arg rid "$rid" --arg rd "$rd" --argjson att "$attempt" --arg rr "$retry_reason" --arg first "$first_usd" \
    --arg pst "${st:-}" --arg ov "$PR_OVERRIDE" --arg te "$PR_TE" --arg ter "$PR_TE_REASON" --argjson drift "$PR_DRIFT" \
    --argjson grc "$PR_GRC" --argjson rrc "$PR_RRC" --argjson secs "$(( t1 - t0 ))" --argjson extra "$PR_EXTRA" \
    '{run_id: $rid, run_dir: $rd, attempts: $att, retry_reason: (if $rr == "" then null else $rr end),
      first_attempt_usd: ($first | tonumber? // 0), pipeline_status: $pst, override: $ov, took_effect: $te,
      took_effect_reason: $ter, drift: $drift, grade_rc: $grc, row_rc: $rrc, seconds: $secs,
      extra_models: $extra}' > "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp"
  mv "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result.tmp" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.result"
}

# --- parent: collect a finished job ---------------------------------------------------
append_and_validate() {  # append_and_validate <row-file> <run_id> → 0 ok; 1 invalid (ROWS_INVALID set)
  local rowf="$1" rid="$2" vout vrc=0 n
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$ROWS"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  if command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1; then
    { flock -x 9; cat "$rowf" >> "$ROWS"; vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || vrc=$?; } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  else
    cat "$rowf" >> "$ROWS"; vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || vrc=$?
  fi
  n="$(grep -cF "\"run_id\":\"$rid\"" "$ROWS" || true)"
  if [[ $vrc -ne 0 ]]; then
    ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --arg e "$(printf '%s' "$vout" | tail -1)" '{run_id: $r, error: $e}')"; return 1
  fi
  if [[ "$n" -ne 1 ]]; then
    ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --argjson n "$n" '{run_id: $r, error: "run_id rowed \($n) times"}')"; return 1
  fi
  return 0
}

# apply_flags <arm> <run_id> <took_effect> <reason> <drift> — a took-effect FAIL pauses the
# arm (DEC-0418); the first drift stops the batch (DEC-0407)
apply_flags() {
  if [[ "$3" == fail ]] && ! is_paused "$1"; then
    PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$1" --arg why "$2: $4" '. + {($a): $why}' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
    log "PAUSED arm $1: $4 (no further trial of $1 launches until --resume --clear-arm $1)"
  fi
  if [[ "$5" != null && "$DRIFT_JSON" == null ]]; then
    DRIFT_JSON="$5"; STOP=drift
    log "DRIFT $2: $5; no further trial launches; the batch fails when the running trials end (DEC-0407)"
  fi
  return 0
}
# record_extra <run_id> <extra models json> — the run's extra models replace its earlier entry
record_extra() {
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$1" --argjson e "$2" \
    'if ($e | type) == "object" and ($e | length) > 0 then .[$r] = ($e | map_values(.output_tokens // 0)) else del(.[$r]) end' <<<"$EXTRA_RUNS_JSON")"
}

# outage_tick <run_id> <row status, empty without a row> — the breaker (DEC-0554): consecutive
# collected transport_error trials (collection order, any arm) trip it at $OUTAGE_BREAKER (0 off)
outage_tick() {
  if [[ "$2" == transport_error ]]; then OUTAGE_RUN=$((OUTAGE_RUN + 1)); else OUTAGE_RUN=0; fi
  if [[ "$OUTAGE_BREAKER" -gt 0 && $OUTAGE_RUN -ge $OUTAGE_BREAKER && "$OUTAGE_JSON" == null && -z "$STOP" ]]; then
    STOP=outage
    OUTAGE_JSON="$(jq -cn --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" --argjson n "$OUTAGE_RUN" --arg r "$1" \
      '{at: $at, consecutive: $n, last_run_id: $r,
        message: "partial (outage breaker): \($n) consecutive transport failures; --resume --rerun-status transport_error after the network is back"}')"
    log "OUTAGE breaker: $OUTAGE_RUN consecutive transport_error trials (last $1); no further trial launches (DEC-0554)"
  fi
  return 0
}

collect() {  # collect <jid> <plan-index>
  local jid="$1" k="$2" arm="${PL_ARM[$2]}" rid="${PL_RUN[$2]}" kind="${PL_KIND[$2]}" res="$JOBS_DIR/$1.result"
  if [[ ! -f "$res" ]]; then
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $rid (the trial job ended without a result; see $BATCH_DIR/$arm/${PL_TASK[$k]}-t${PL_TRIAL[$k]}.log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
    outage_tick "$rid" ""
    rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*; write_status; return 0
  fi
  local first att rr te ter drift
  first="$(jq -r '.first_attempt_usd' "$res")" att="$(jq -r '.attempts' "$res")" rr="$(jq -r '.retry_reason // ""' "$res")"
  te="$(jq -r '.took_effect' "$res")" ter="$(jq -r '.took_effect_reason' "$res")" drift="$(jq -c '.drift' "$res")"
  record_extra "$rid" "$(jq -c '.extra_models // {}' "$res")"
  if [[ "$att" -ge 2 ]]; then
    RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg why "$rr" --arg u "$first" '. + [{run_id: $r, reason: $why, first_attempt_usd: ($u | tonumber)}]' <<<"$RETRIES_JSON")"
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$first")"; LEDGER_USD="$(fadd "$LEDGER_USD" "$first")"
  fi
  local st="" cost deg pass
  if [[ -s "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" ]]; then
    IFS=$'\t' read -r st cost deg pass < <(jq -r '[.status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring),
        ((.hidden_test_pass_rate // .defect_catch_rate // "n/a") | tostring)] | @tsv' "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row")
    if is_rerun "$rid"; then
      # DEC-0553: the new row replaces the old one in place; the old row's reported cost moves to the ledger
      if replace_row_try "$rid" "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row"; then
        local from ocost
        from="$(jq -r --arg r "$rid" '.[$r].status' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")" ocost="$(jq -r --arg r "$rid" '.[$r].cost' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        LEDGER_USD="$(fadd "$LEDGER_USD" "$ocost")"
        RERUN_LIST="${RERUN_LIST/$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'/$'\n'}"
        RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "$from" --arg t "$st" --arg c "$ocost" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
          '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, old_cost_usd: ($c | tonumber), at: $at}]' <<<"$RERUN_JSON")"
        log "rerun $rid: $from → $st (row replaced in place)"
      else
        ROWS_INVALID="$(jq -cn --arg r "$rid" --arg e "$REPLACE_ERR" '{run_id: $r, error: ("rerun replacement: " + $e)}')"
        log "ROWS INVALID after $rid: $(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID")"; STOP=invalid
      fi
    elif append_and_validate "$JOBS_DIR/$jid.row" "$rid"; then :; else
      log "ROWS INVALID after $rid: $(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID")"; STOP=invalid
    fi
    DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
    account_row "$arm" "$kind" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    log "done $rid $st pass=$pass USD $cost $(( $(jq -r '.seconds' "$res") / 60 ))m attempts $att${rr:+ ($rr)}"
  else
    SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$RUN_CAP")"; ASSUMED_CAP=$((ASSUMED_CAP + 1))
    log "FAILED $rid: no row written (ablation-row.sh exit $(jq -r '.row_rc' "$res"); see the trial log); assumed cap: USD $RUN_CAP charged to spent"
  fi
  outage_tick "$rid" "$st"
  apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$te" "$ter" "$drift"
  rm -f "$JOBS_DIR/$jid".*
  write_status
}

PIDS=() PJOB=() PIDX=()
watchdog_tick() {
  local j f pid start wds now rd t0
  now="$(date +%s)"
  for j in ${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}; do
    f="$JOBS_DIR/$j.pgid"; [[ -f "$f" ]] || continue
    read -r pid start wds < "$f" 2>/dev/null || continue
    [[ -n "$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE" ]] && wds="$WATCHDOG_OVERRIDE"
    [[ $(( now - start )) -gt $wds ]] || continue
    rd="$(cat "$JOBS_DIR/$j.rundir" 2>/dev/null || true)"
    [[ -z "$(final_status "$rd")" ]] || continue
    if [[ ! -f "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd" ]]; then
      printf '%s\n' "$now" > "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd"
      log "watchdog: $j has no final pipeline record after ${wds}s (twice its phase-sum timeout); SIGTERM to process group $pid"
      kill -TERM -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -TERM "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
    elif [[ ! -f "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wdkill" ]]; then
      read -r t0 < "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wd" || t0="$now"
      if [[ $(( now - t0 )) -ge $WATCHDOG_GRACE ]]; then
        : > "$JOBS_DIR/$j.wdkill"
        log "watchdog: $j still running ${WATCHDOG_GRACE}s after SIGTERM; SIGKILL to process group $pid"
        kill -KILL -- "-$pid" 2>/dev/null || kill -KILL "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true
      fi
    fi
  done
  return 0
}
reap() {  # reap until fewer than $1 jobs run
  local i
  while [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]]; do
    for i in "${!PIDS[@]}"; do
      if ! kill -0 "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null; then
        wait "${PIDS[$i]}" 2>/dev/null || true
        collect "${PJOB[$i]}" "${PIDX[$i]}"
        unset 'PIDS[i]' 'PJOB[i]' 'PIDX[i]'
        PIDS=("${PIDS[@]+"${PIDS[@]}"}"); PJOB=("${PJOB[@]+"${PJOB[@]}"}"); PIDX=("${PIDX[@]+"${PIDX[@]}"}")
        break
      fi
    done
    watchdog_tick
    [[ ${#PIDS[@]} -ge $1 ]] && sleep "$POLL_S"
  done
  return 0
}

on_signal() {
  SIGNALLED=true
  log "interrupted: the driver received a signal; running trials are signalled and will be rerun by --resume"
  STATE=partial; write_status
  exit 1
}

finish() {  # finish <state> <exit> <message>
  STATE="$1"; write_status; log "$3"
  local line
  line="$("$SPEND_BIN" 2>/dev/null | tail -1 || true)"
  {
    printf '%s %s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "${line:-spend.sh printed nothing}"
    printf '%s batch %s spend USD %s (rows %s + first attempts %s; %s assumed cap charge(s)); max %s\n' \
      "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$BATCH" "$SPENT" "$ROWS_USD" "$LEDGER_USD" "$ASSUMED_CAP" "${MAX_USD:-none}"
  } >> "$BATCH_DIR/spend.txt"
  echo "run-ablation: $3"
  echo "batch: $BATCH_DIR"
  exit "$2"

content.content:
exit "$2"
}

# --- --rerow: the post-run chain again over a rowed run dir, the row replaced in place ---
# replace_row_try <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; 1 with REPLACE_ERR set and the rows file
# untouched (the old row stays). replace_row is the --rerow form: it dies instead
replace_row_try() {
  local rid="$1" newf="$2" tmp="$ROWS.rerow.$$" rc=0 vout="" perr
  REPLACE_ERR=""
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$tmp"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  {
    command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && flock -x 9
    perr="$(python3 -I - "$ROWS" "$tmp" "$BATCH" "$rid" "$newf" 2>&1 <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows, tmp, batch, rid, newf = sys.argv[1:6]
new = open(newf, encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
out, n = [], 0
with open(rows, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    for line in fh:
        try: o = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError: o = None
        if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("batch") == batch and o.get("run_id") == rid:
            n += 1; out.append(new + "\n")
        else:
            out.append(line if line.endswith("\n") else line + "\n")
if n != 1:
    print("run_id %s has %d rows" % (rid, n), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: fh.writelines(out)
PY
)" || rc=$?
    if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then
      vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || rc=$?
      if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then mv "$tmp" "$ROWS"; else REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$vout" | tail -1)"; fi
    else
      REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$perr" | tail -1)"
    fi
  } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  rm -f "$tmp"
  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || { REPLACE_ERR="${REPLACE_ERR:-exit $rc}"; return 1; }
  return 0
}
replace_row() {  # replace_row <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; dies (rows file untouched) otherwise
  replace_row_try "$1" "$2" && return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$REPLACE_ERR" >&2
  die "rerow $1: the replacement did not validate or the row moved ($REPLACE_ERR); $ROWS unchanged"
}
rerow_all() {
  local n k rid arm task trial rd tlog newst
  for n in "${!RR_K[@]}"; do
    k="${RR_K[$n]}" rid="${PL_RUN[${RR_K[$n]}]}" arm="${PL_ARM[${RR_K[$n]}]}" task="${PL_TASK[${RR_K[$n]}]}"
    trial="${PL_TRIAL[${RR_K[$n]}]}" rd="${RR_RD[$n]}" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
    printf '%s run-ablation: rerow %s run_dir %s (was %s)\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$rd" "${RR_FROM[$n]}" >> "$tlog"
    rm -f "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${RR_ATT[$n]}" "${RR_REASON[$n]}" "$(final_status "$rd")" "" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" "$tlog"
    [[ -s "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" ]] || die "rerow $rid: ablation-row.sh wrote no row (exit $PR_RRC; see $tlog); $ROWS unchanged"
    replace_row "$rid" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    newst="$(jq -r '.status' "$WORK/rerow-$n.row")"
    record_extra "$rid" "$PR_EXTRA"
    apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$PR_TE" "$PR_TE_REASON" "$PR_DRIFT"
    REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "${RR_FROM[$n]}" --arg t "$newst" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, at: $at}]' <<<"$REROWED_JSON")"
    jq --argjson r "$REROWED_JSON" '.rerowed = $r' "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json" > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" \
      && mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
    log "rerow $rid: ${RR_FROM[$n]} → $newst"
  done
  return 0
}

# --- --resume reconciliation: rows on disk are the truth (after --rerow) --------
if [[ "$RESUME" == true ]]; then
  ST_PATH="$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
  STARTED="$(jq -r '.started // empty' "$ST_PATH")"; [[ -n "$STARTED" ]] || STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c '.cuts // []' "$ST_PATH")"; RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c '.retries // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c '.paused_arms // {}' "$ST_PATH")"
  LEDGER_USD="$(jq -r '.spend.ledger_usd // 0' "$ST_PATH")"; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$LEDGER_USD")"
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c '.extra_models_by_run // {} | if type == "object" then . else {} end' "$ST_PATH")"
  DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c '.drift_cleared // []' "$ST_PATH")"; REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerowed // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerun // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c '.outage_history // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  if [[ "$(jq -c '.outage // null' "$ST_PATH")" != null ]]; then
    OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson o "$(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH")" '. + [$o]' <<<"$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON")"
    log "resume: the outage breaker record $(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH") is cleared (kept under outage_history)"
  fi
  if [[ "$CLEAR_PENDING" != null ]]; then
    DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CLEAR_PENDING" '. + [$c]' <<<"$DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON")"
    log "resume: --clear-drift $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$CLEAR_PENDING") (previous drift re-read under the current rule: none)"
  fi
  for a in ${CLEAR_ARMS[@]+"${CLEAR_ARMS[@]}"}; do
    if is_paused "$a"; then PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$a" 'del(.[$a])' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"; log "resume: --clear-arm $a (paused arm released)"
    else log "resume: --clear-arm $a: the arm is not paused"; fi
  done
  # rerows first, so spend and per_arm below come from the final rows
  rerow_all
  if [[ -f "$ROWS" ]]; then
    dup="$(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b) | .run_id' "$ROWS" | sort | uniq -d | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
    [[ -z "$dup" ]] || refuse "resume: $ROWS holds run_id(s) twice: $dup"
    want_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"}; do want_ids="$want_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    rerow_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do rerow_ids="$rerow_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    want_st=" ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"} "
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r rid st cost deg; do
      k=-1
      for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
      [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || continue
      if [[ "$want_ids" == *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]] \
         || { [[ "$want_st" == *" $st "* ]] && [[ "$rerow_ids" != *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]]; }; then
        # DEC-0553: out of the done set, so the plan launches it again; no counter, no assumed charge;
        # its reported cost (real spend) stays in spent
        [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
        RERUN_LIST="$RERUN_LIST$rid"$'\n'; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
        RERUN_OLD="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg s "$st" --arg c "$cost" '.[$r] = {status: $s, cost: ($c | tonumber)}' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        continue
      fi
      DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
      i="$(arm_index "${PL_ARM[$k]}")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
      account_row "${PL_ARM[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    done < <(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b)
               | [.run_id, .status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring)] | @tsv' "$ROWS")
  fi
  n_rerun="$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | grep -c . || true)"
  [[ ${#RERUN_STATUSES[@]} -eq 0 && ${#RERUN_IDS[@]} -eq 0 ]] \
    || log "resume: $n_rerun trial(s) flagged for a rerun (--rerun ${RERUN_IDS[*]+"${RERUN_IDS[*]}"} --rerun-status ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"}; DEC-0553)"
  log "resume: batch $BATCH, $LAUNCHED of $PLAN_N trials rowed, spent $SPENT, paused $(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
fi

# --- dispatch --------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "start batch=$BATCH smoke=$SMOKE source=${SRC_FULL:0:12} executor=$EXECUTOR image=$IMAGE cli=$CLI_VERSION concurrency=$CONCURRENCY rows=$ROWS"
log "$PLAN_LINE"
[[ "$RESUME" == true ]] || jq -r '.refused[] | "refused: \(.arm) \(.task_id) \(.type) (task_types \(.task_types | tojson)) DEC-0405"' "$WORK/plan.json" \
  | while IFS= read -r l; do log "$l"; done
write_status
trap on_signal INT TERM HUP

n=0
for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do
  rid="${PL_RUN[$k]}" a="${PL_ARM[$k]}"
  is_done "$rid" && continue
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  if [[ -n "$MAX_USD" ]] && ! budget_gate "$a|${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$((k + 1))" "${PL_KIND[$k]}"; then
    CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CUT_JSON" '. + [$c]' <<<"$CUTS_JSON")"; STOP=cut; write_status; break
  fi
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "${PL_TASK[$k]}" "${PL_TYPE[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "${PL_TRIAL[$k]}" "$rid" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${PL_WD[$k]}" &
  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PIDX+=("$k")
  i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
  log "launch $rid ($a ${PL_TASK[$k]} ${PL_TYPE[$k]} t${PL_TRIAL[$k]})"
done
reap 1

# --- the batch's end state ---------------------------------------------------------------
total_completed=0 left=0 excluded=0
for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_completed=$(( total_completed + ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} )); excluded=$(( excluded + ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} )); done
for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do is_done "${PL_RUN[$k]}" || left=$((left + 1)); done
paused_n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
if [[ "$ROWS_INVALID" != null ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: the rows file is invalid after $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID") ($(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID"))"
elif [[ "$DRIFT_JSON" != null ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: drift in $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON") ($(jq -r '.field' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"): expected $(jq -c '.expected' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"), got $(jq -c '.got' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"))"
elif [[ "$OUTAGE_JSON" != null ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "$(jq -r '.message' <<<"$OUTAGE_JSON")"
elif [[ "$CUTS_JSON" != '[]' && $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial (cut max_usd): $((PLAN_N - left)) of $PLAN_N rowed, spent $SPENT"
elif [[ $total_completed -eq 0 ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: no trial completed ($((PLAN_N - left)) rowed, $left without a row)"
elif [[ $paused_n -gt 0 && $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  if [[ "$paused_n" -ge "${#ARMS[@]}" ]]; then
    finish failed 3 "failed: every arm is paused by took-effect ($(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")); $left trials left"
  fi
  finish partial 1 "partial: paused arm(s) $(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON") left $left trials; --resume --clear-arm <id> after reading the cause"
elif [[ $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial: $left of $PLAN_N trials have no row (see run.log)"
elif [[ $excluded -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial: all $PLAN_N trials rowed, $excluded excluded (transport, infrastructure, interrupted or contaminated)"
else
  finish complete 0 "complete: $PLAN_N trials rowed, spent $SPENT"
fi

tool_use_result.stdout:
exit "$2"
}

# --- --rerow: the post-run chain again over a rowed run dir, the row replaced in place ---
# replace_row_try <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; 1 with REPLACE_ERR set and the rows file
# untouched (the old row stays). replace_row is the --rerow form: it dies instead
replace_row_try() {
  local rid="$1" newf="$2" tmp="$ROWS.rerow.$$" rc=0 vout="" perr
  REPLACE_ERR=""
  local -a v=("$ROW_BIN" --validate "$tmp"); [[ "$SMOKE" == true ]] && v+=(--allow-ungraded)
  {
    command -v flock >/dev/null 2>&1 && flock -x 9
    perr="$(python3 -I - "$ROWS" "$tmp" "$BATCH" "$rid" "$newf" 2>&1 <<'PY'
import json, sys
rows, tmp, batch, rid, newf = sys.argv[1:6]
new = open(newf, encoding="utf-8").read().strip()
out, n = [], 0
with open(rows, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
    for line in fh:
        try: o = json.loads(line)
        except ValueError: o = None
        if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("batch") == batch and o.get("run_id") == rid:
            n += 1; out.append(new + "\n")
        else:
            out.append(line if line.endswith("\n") else line + "\n")
if n != 1:
    print("run_id %s has %d rows" % (rid, n), file=sys.stderr); sys.exit(1)
with open(tmp, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh: fh.writelines(out)
PY
)" || rc=$?
    if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then
      vout="$("${v[@]}" 2>&1)" || rc=$?
      if [[ $rc -eq 0 ]]; then mv "$tmp" "$ROWS"; else REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$vout" | tail -1)"; fi
    else
      REPLACE_ERR="$(printf '%s\n' "$perr" | tail -1)"
    fi
  } 9>>"$ROWS.lock"
  rm -f "$tmp"
  [[ $rc -eq 0 ]] || { REPLACE_ERR="${REPLACE_ERR:-exit $rc}"; return 1; }
  return 0
}
replace_row() {  # replace_row <run_id> <new-row-file> → 0 replaced; dies (rows file untouched) otherwise
  replace_row_try "$1" "$2" && return 0
  printf '%s\n' "$REPLACE_ERR" >&2
  die "rerow $1: the replacement did not validate or the row moved ($REPLACE_ERR); $ROWS unchanged"
}
rerow_all() {
  local n k rid arm task trial rd tlog newst
  for n in "${!RR_K[@]}"; do
    k="${RR_K[$n]}" rid="${PL_RUN[${RR_K[$n]}]}" arm="${PL_ARM[${RR_K[$n]}]}" task="${PL_TASK[${RR_K[$n]}]}"
    trial="${PL_TRIAL[${RR_K[$n]}]}" rd="${RR_RD[$n]}" tlog="$BATCH_DIR/$arm/$task-t$trial.log"
    printf '%s run-ablation: rerow %s run_dir %s (was %s)\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" "$rid" "$rd" "${RR_FROM[$n]}" >> "$tlog"
    rm -f "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    post_run "$rd" "$rid" "$task" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${RR_ATT[$n]}" "${RR_REASON[$n]}" "$(final_status "$rd")" "" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" "$tlog"
    [[ -s "$WORK/rerow-$n.row" ]] || die "rerow $rid: ablation-row.sh wrote no row (exit $PR_RRC; see $tlog); $ROWS unchanged"
    replace_row "$rid" "$WORK/rerow-$n.row"
    newst="$(jq -r '.status' "$WORK/rerow-$n.row")"
    record_extra "$rid" "$PR_EXTRA"
    apply_flags "$arm" "$rid" "$PR_TE" "$PR_TE_REASON" "$PR_DRIFT"
    REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg f "${RR_FROM[$n]}" --arg t "$newst" --arg at "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)" \
      '. + [{run_id: $r, from: $f, to: $t, at: $at}]' <<<"$REROWED_JSON")"
    jq --argjson r "$REROWED_JSON" '.rerowed = $r' "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json" > "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" \
      && mv "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json.tmp" "$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
    log "rerow $rid: ${RR_FROM[$n]} → $newst"
  done
  return 0
}

# --- --resume reconciliation: rows on disk are the truth (after --rerow) --------
if [[ "$RESUME" == true ]]; then
  ST_PATH="$BATCH_DIR/STATUS.json"
  STARTED="$(jq -r '.started // empty' "$ST_PATH")"; [[ -n "$STARTED" ]] || STARTED="$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
  CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c '.cuts // []' "$ST_PATH")"; RETRIES_JSON="$(jq -c '.retries // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c '.paused_arms // {}' "$ST_PATH")"
  LEDGER_USD="$(jq -r '.spend.ledger_usd // 0' "$ST_PATH")"; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$LEDGER_USD")"
  EXTRA_RUNS_JSON="$(jq -c '.extra_models_by_run // {} | if type == "object" then . else {} end' "$ST_PATH")"
  DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c '.drift_cleared // []' "$ST_PATH")"; REROWED_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerowed // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  RERUN_JSON="$(jq -c '.rerun // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c '.outage_history // []' "$ST_PATH")"
  if [[ "$(jq -c '.outage // null' "$ST_PATH")" != null ]]; then
    OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson o "$(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH")" '. + [$o]' <<<"$OUTAGE_HISTORY_JSON")"
    log "resume: the outage breaker record $(jq -c '.outage' "$ST_PATH") is cleared (kept under outage_history)"
  fi
  if [[ "$CLEAR_PENDING" != null ]]; then
    DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CLEAR_PENDING" '. + [$c]' <<<"$DRIFT_CLEARED_JSON")"
    log "resume: --clear-drift $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$CLEAR_PENDING") (previous drift re-read under the current rule: none)"
  fi
  for a in ${CLEAR_ARMS[@]+"${CLEAR_ARMS[@]}"}; do
    if is_paused "$a"; then PAUSED_JSON="$(jq -c --arg a "$a" 'del(.[$a])' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"; log "resume: --clear-arm $a (paused arm released)"
    else log "resume: --clear-arm $a: the arm is not paused"; fi
  done
  # rerows first, so spend and per_arm below come from the final rows
  rerow_all
  if [[ -f "$ROWS" ]]; then
    dup="$(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b) | .run_id' "$ROWS" | sort | uniq -d | head -3 | tr '\n' ' ')"
    [[ -z "$dup" ]] || refuse "resume: $ROWS holds run_id(s) twice: $dup"
    want_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${RERUN_IDS[@]+"${RERUN_IDS[@]}"}; do want_ids="$want_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    rerow_ids=$'\n'; for r in ${REROW_IDS[@]+"${REROW_IDS[@]}"}; do rerow_ids="$rerow_ids$r"$'\n'; done
    want_st=" ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"} "
    while IFS=$'\t' read -r rid st cost deg; do
      k=-1
      for j in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do [[ "${PL_RUN[$j]}" == "$rid" ]] && { k=$j; break; }; done
      [[ $k -ge 0 ]] || continue
      if [[ "$want_ids" == *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]] \
         || { [[ "$want_st" == *" $st "* ]] && [[ "$rerow_ids" != *$'\n'"$rid"$'\n'* ]]; }; then
        # DEC-0553: out of the done set, so the plan launches it again; no counter, no assumed charge;
        # its reported cost (real spend) stays in spent
        [[ "$cost" =~ ^[0-9]+(\.[0-9]+)?([eE][-+]?[0-9]+)?$ ]] || cost=0
        RERUN_LIST="$RERUN_LIST$rid"$'\n'; SPENT="$(fadd "$SPENT" "$cost")"
        RERUN_OLD="$(jq -c --arg r "$rid" --arg s "$st" --arg c "$cost" '.[$r] = {status: $s, cost: ($c | tonumber)}' <<<"$RERUN_OLD")"
        continue
      fi
      DONE_LIST="$DONE_LIST$rid"$'\n'
      i="$(arm_index "${PL_ARM[$k]}")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
      account_row "${PL_ARM[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$rid" "$st" "$cost" "$deg"
    done < <(jq -R -r --arg b "$BATCH" 'fromjson? | select(type == "object" and .batch == $b)
               | [.run_id, .status, ((.cost_usd // 0) | tostring), ((.degraded // false) | tostring)] | @tsv' "$ROWS")
  fi
  n_rerun="$(printf '%s' "$RERUN_LIST" | grep -c . || true)"
  [[ ${#RERUN_STATUSES[@]} -eq 0 && ${#RERUN_IDS[@]} -eq 0 ]] \
    || log "resume: $n_rerun trial(s) flagged for a rerun (--rerun ${RERUN_IDS[*]+"${RERUN_IDS[*]}"} --rerun-status ${RERUN_STATUSES[*]+"${RERUN_STATUSES[*]}"}; DEC-0553)"
  log "resume: batch $BATCH, $LAUNCHED of $PLAN_N trials rowed, spent $SPENT, paused $(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
fi

# --- dispatch --------------------------------------------------------------------------
log "start batch=$BATCH smoke=$SMOKE source=${SRC_FULL:0:12} executor=$EXECUTOR image=$IMAGE cli=$CLI_VERSION concurrency=$CONCURRENCY rows=$ROWS"
log "$PLAN_LINE"
[[ "$RESUME" == true ]] || jq -r '.refused[] | "refused: \(.arm) \(.task_id) \(.type) (task_types \(.task_types | tojson)) DEC-0405"' "$WORK/plan.json" \
  | while IFS= read -r l; do log "$l"; done
write_status
trap on_signal INT TERM HUP

n=0
for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do
  rid="${PL_RUN[$k]}" a="${PL_ARM[$k]}"
  is_done "$rid" && continue
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  reap "$CONCURRENCY"
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  if [[ -n "$MAX_USD" ]] && ! budget_gate "$a|${PL_KIND[$k]}" "$((k + 1))" "${PL_KIND[$k]}"; then
    CUTS_JSON="$(jq -c --argjson c "$CUT_JSON" '. + [$c]' <<<"$CUTS_JSON")"; STOP=cut; write_status; break
  fi
  [[ -z "$STOP" ]] || break
  if is_paused "$a"; then i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_SKIPPED[$i]=$(( ${C_SKIPPED[$i]} + 1 )); continue; fi
  n=$((n + 1)); jid="$(printf 'j%04d' "$n")"
  run_trial "$jid" "$a" "${PL_TASK[$k]}" "${PL_TYPE[$k]}" "${PL_KIND[$k]}" "${PL_TRIAL[$k]}" "$rid" "${PL_YAML[$k]}" "${PL_WD[$k]}" &
  PIDS+=("$!"); PJOB+=("$jid"); PIDX+=("$k")
  i="$(arm_index "$a")"; C_LAUNCHED[$i]=$(( ${C_LAUNCHED[$i]} + 1 )); LAUNCHED=$((LAUNCHED + 1))
  log "launch $rid ($a ${PL_TASK[$k]} ${PL_TYPE[$k]} t${PL_TRIAL[$k]})"
done
reap 1

# --- the batch's end state ---------------------------------------------------------------
total_completed=0 left=0 excluded=0
for i in "${!ARMS[@]}"; do total_completed=$(( total_completed + ${C_COMPLETED[$i]} )); excluded=$(( excluded + ${C_EXCLUDED[$i]} )); done
for k in "${!PL_RUN[@]}"; do is_done "${PL_RUN[$k]}" || left=$((left + 1)); done
paused_n="$(jq 'length' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")"
if [[ "$ROWS_INVALID" != null ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: the rows file is invalid after $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID") ($(jq -r '.error' <<<"$ROWS_INVALID"))"
elif [[ "$DRIFT_JSON" != null ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: drift in $(jq -r '.run_id' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON") ($(jq -r '.field' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"): expected $(jq -c '.expected' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"), got $(jq -c '.got' <<<"$DRIFT_JSON"))"
elif [[ "$OUTAGE_JSON" != null ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "$(jq -r '.message' <<<"$OUTAGE_JSON")"
elif [[ "$CUTS_JSON" != '[]' && $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial (cut max_usd): $((PLAN_N - left)) of $PLAN_N rowed, spent $SPENT"
elif [[ $total_completed -eq 0 ]]; then
  finish failed 3 "failed: no trial completed ($((PLAN_N - left)) rowed, $left without a row)"
elif [[ $paused_n -gt 0 && $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  if [[ "$paused_n" -ge "${#ARMS[@]}" ]]; then
    finish failed 3 "failed: every arm is paused by took-effect ($(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON")); $left trials left"
  fi
  finish partial 1 "partial: paused arm(s) $(jq -c 'keys' <<<"$PAUSED_JSON") left $left trials; --resume --clear-arm <id> after reading the cause"
elif [[ $left -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial: $left of $PLAN_N trials have no row (see run.log)"
elif [[ $excluded -gt 0 ]]; then
  finish partial 1 "partial: all $PLAN_N trials rowed, $excluded excluded (transport, infrastructure, interrupted or contaminated)"
else
  finish complete 0 "complete: $PLAN_N trials rowed, spent $SPENT"
fi

# =============================================================================
# evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml — cycle-130 Loa 2.0 component ablation suite
#
# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the
# tasks block with the smoke root, phase_defaults, phase_sets, cost_hint, each
# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered
# rules block (D-A5; mirrored in NOTES before the first run, DEC-0383).
#
# Readers: execute-agent.sh / lib/sandbox-mount.sh (arms[].toggles via
# resolve_arm_toggles), pipeline-run.sh (phase_defaults, phase_sets,
# arms[].phases, arms[].effort), took-effect.sh (arms[].took_effect),
# run-ablation.sh (trials, caps, priority, cut_ladder, arms[].task_types),
# ablation-report.py (rules), validate-suite.sh (arm ids for the leakage check,
# task_types against the known types).
#
# task_types: `all` | `build` (= feature-build, bug-fix, refactor) |
#   `review-catch` | a single build type. An arm is never scheduled, and a row
#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).
# took_effect: rule ids took-effect.sh evaluates per trial (DEC-0418); a miss is
#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the
#   smoke's evidence line that the planner refused the arm on a review-catch task.
# =============================================================================
name: ablation-2.0
version: 1
source_commit: "ba11b860"   # the pin: the Sprint 259 completion tree (rc.5 + the #1267 mount fix + the harness; .claude/ identical to the Sprint 258 completion tree, DEC-0529; the per-batch .claude/ delta vs 4d69c3c4 is in MANIFEST.json, DEC-0392)
agy_opt_in: false
tasks:
  root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/tasks
  manifest: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/MANIFEST.sha256
  smoke_root: grimoires/loa/evals/ablation-2.0/smoke
suite_version: 1
trials: {build: 3, review-catch: 3}      # D-A4: review-catch trials 3, not 5, under the gate pipeline
cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3
caps: {cycle_usd: 1500, run_usd: 12, reserve_usd: 250}   # reserve released to A7 when the re-verification rule needs no run (DEC-0398)
priority: [a0_bare, a1_full, a2_no_sprint_plan, a3_one_voice, a4_no_gates, a7_effort_medium, a5_no_flatline, a6_one_window]
cost_hint: {build: 7, review-catch: 8}   # USD per run before any actual exists (run-arms/run-ablation est_next fallback)

# Session defaults per phase (SDD D-4.3). A6's continued session carries the
# caps of the phase it is in; A0's BARE caps are PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX.
phase_defaults:
  models:
    PLAN: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    IMPLEMENT: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    FIX: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    BARE: global.anthropic.claude-opus-5-5
    REVIEW: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
    AUDIT: global.anthropic.claude-fable-5-1
  # REVIEW/AUDIT 60 turns / 30 min: the Sprint 258 smoke saw a review-catch AUDIT hit 40 turns after writing its
  # verdict (DEC-0490); BARE stays the implementer-side sum (PLAN + IMPLEMENT + 2 x FIX)
  max_turns: {PLAN: 30, IMPLEMENT: 60, REVIEW: 60, FIX: 40, AUDIT: 60, BARE: 170}
  timeout_min: {PLAN: 15, IMPLEMENT: 25, REVIEW: 30, FIX: 15, AUDIT: 30, BARE: 70}
  tools: "Bash,Read,Grep,Glob,Write,Edit,Task,WebFetch"   # identical for every arm, A0 included
phase_sets:   # D-4.1: A1's phases per task type; FIX runs only after a CHANGES_REQUIRED gate
  review-catch: [REVIEW, AUDIT]
  build: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX]

arms:
  - {id: a0_bare, label: A0, task_types: [all], toggles: {loa_mount: false}, phases: [BARE], effort: high,
     took_effect: [no_dot_claude, no_system_prompt, no_audit_rows, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a1_full, label: A1, task_types: [all], toggles: {}, took_effect: [all_phases_present, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a2_no_sprint_plan, label: A2, task_types: [build], toggles: {sprint_plan: false},
     phases: [IMPLEMENT, REVIEW, FIX, AUDIT, FIX],
     took_effect: [no_plan_phase, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a3_one_voice, label: A3, task_types: [all], toggles: {companion_voice: false}, took_effect: [one_voice_planned, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a4_no_gates, label: A4, task_types: [build], toggles: {gates: false},
     phases: [PLAN, IMPLEMENT],
     took_effect: [no_gate_phases, enforce_env_false, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}   # build only: on a review-catch task the gates are the task (DEC-0400)
  - {id: a5_no_flatline, label: A5, task_types: [build], toggles: {flatline: false},
     took_effect: [no_flatline_rows, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a6_one_window, label: A6, task_types: [build], toggles: {context_resets: false},
     took_effect: [implementer_single_session, gates_separate_sessions, applicability_refused, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a7_effort_medium, label: A7, task_types: [all], toggles: {effort: medium},
     took_effect: [effort_flag_medium, skill_effort_stripped, integrity_clean]}
  - {id: a8_no_ceremonies, label: A8, absent: true,
     evidence: "no /meeting command, skill or sosyete config key at 4d69c3c4 (grep -rli sosyete .claude/ docs/; ls .claude/commands .claude/skills)"}

rules:   # D-A5: pre-registered, mirrored in NOTES
  threshold_points: 0.03
  cost_lower_pct: 15
  bootstrap: {resamples: 10000, level: 0.90, paired: true, units: {hidden_test_pass_rate: tasks, defect_catch_rate: defects}, also_report: {defect_catch_rate: tasks}}   # DEC-0399
  primaries_by_arm: {build_only: [hidden_test_pass_rate], all_types: [hidden_test_pass_rate, defect_catch_rate]}   # DEC-0400
  cap_failure: counts_as_failed            # 0 on each applicable primary (DEC-0393)
  exclusion: {statuses: [degraded, contaminated, interrupted], mode: pairwise, inconclusive_above_share: 0.25}
  sensitivity_figure: cap_failures_excluded  # printed, never decides
  multiple_comparisons: none                 # expected false positives at 0.90 over 6 components printed
  drift_guard: {cli_version: fixed_per_batch, model_ids: fixed_per_batch}   # DEC-0407
  order: trial_major_seeded_shuffle_within_block
  took_effect_per_trial: true                # a miss → infrastructure_error, arm paused until --clear-arm (DEC-0418)
  predicates:                                # DEC-0416, DEC-0393, DEC-0530; d = arm − A1 point estimate, [lo, hi] its 90 % interval, c/w = cost/wall-clock Δ %; evaluated in this order
    inconclusive_by_degradation: "the arm's excluded share > 0.25 (whatever its interval; DEC-0393)"
    investigate: "else any applicable primary has lo > 0"
    keep: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03 and hi < 0"
    inconclusive: "else any applicable primary has d < -0.03, or no valid pair"
    remove: "else every applicable primary has d >= -0.03 and (c <= -15 or w <= -15)"
    simplify: "else (every applicable primary within -0.03, cost similar)"
  review_catch: {defect_counts_once_across_gates: true, false_positive_dedupe: cited_region, verdict_accurate_iff: "CHANGES_REQUIRED when the key holds a high or critical defect, APPROVED when none"}   # DEC-0420
  inconclusive_extension_trials: 2
  h1: "a1_full beats a0_bare on at least one primary with the interval excluding zero, else halt before promotion"
  a4_sensitivity: "a4_no_gates worse than a1_full on hidden_test_pass_rate with the interval excluding zero, else harden tasks before acting on other arms"
  decision_states: [investigate, keep, inconclusive, remove, simplify, not_run_cut, inconclusive_by_power]
  mde_cut: 0.10   # sprint Task 3.4: an arm whose MDE at affordable trials exceeds this is pre-declared inconclusive_by_power and not run

# SDD §3.3 (structure reproduced), extended by Sprint 258 Task 1.6: the

# arm's phase-set override and took-effect rule ids, and the full pre-registered

#   never reported, on a type outside its declaration (DEC-0400, DEC-0406).

#   infrastructure_error and pauses the arm. `applicability_refused` is the

cut_ladder: ["A5, A6, A7 not run", "A2 and A3 build trials 3 -> 2", "A3 review-catch trials 3 -> 2"]   # DEC-0397; A0, A1, A4 keep 3

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# =============================================================================
# ablation-report.py — the cycle-130 ablation report (PRD FR-8, SDD §5.12, §4.2)
#
# Reads runs.jsonl rows (SDD §3.1, ablation-row.sh), the batch MANIFEST.json files
# (SDD §3.4, run-ablation.sh) and the suite file (evals/suites/ablation-2.0.yaml:
# arms[], trials, cut_ladder, priority and the pre-registered `rules` block, D-A5),
# applies the pre-registered rules to every component arm (A2 … A7) against the
# control a1_full, checks H1 (a1_full vs a0_bare) and the A4 sensitivity rule, and
# writes report.md (and a --json twin with the same numbers).
#
# Usage:
#   ablation-report.py --runs F [--runs F ...] --manifests DIR [--manifests DIR ...]
#                      --suite F --out report.md [--json report.json]
#                      [--seed 20261015] [--resamples N] [--level L]
#                      [--exclude-degraded true|false] [--partial]
#                      [--cuts F] [--not-run CSV]
#
# Options:
#   --runs F            a runs.jsonl file (repeatable). Every non-blank line is one row
#                       and must carry schema_version 1 (an integer, or a "1.x" string);
#                       a row with another major, no schema_version, or a line that is not
#                       a JSON object stops the report (exit 2, naming file:line and run_id).
#                       A run_id seen twice keeps its last row (the earlier one is listed).
#   --manifests DIR     a directory searched recursively (symlinks not followed) for
#                       MANIFEST.json files (repeatable). Each gives a batch's provenance:
#                       batch, arm_map, shuffle_seed, source_commit, suite_manifest_sha256,
#                       suite_version, pre_registration_ref, cli_version (top level or
#                       executor.cli_version), image_digest, smoke. A manifest with an
#                       unknown schema_version major, two manifests claiming one batch, or
#                       an arm_map entry disagreeing with a row's arm → exit 2.
#   --suite F           the suite file: YAML read through `yq -o=json` (mikefarah yq v4,
#                       as arms-report.py does), or JSON when the file parses as JSON.
#                       The Method section quotes its `rules:` block verbatim.
#   --out F             report.md (the only files written are --out and --json; a symlink
#                       at either path is refused)
#   --json F            the JSON twin (schema_version 1)
#   --seed N            bootstrap seed (default 20261015); every interval uses its own
#                       random.Random(seed), so a figure does not depend on which other
#                       arms are present
#   --resamples N       default rules.bootstrap.resamples (10,000); a value other than the
#                       pre-registered one is marked in the header
#   --level L           default rules.bootstrap.level (0.90); same marking
#   --exclude-degraded  true (default) | false: rows with degraded: true are excluded
#                       pairwise (rules.exclusion.statuses names `degraded`)
#   --partial           prints "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"; exit 1 when no
#                       comparison (A2–A7, H1, A4) has a valid pair on every primary it uses
#   --cuts F            a JSON list of {arm, reason, figure[, state]} the lead recorded;
#                       arm is an id (a5_no_flatline) or a label (A5); state is not_run_cut
#                       (default) or inconclusive_by_power (a pre-declared power cut)
#   --not-run CSV       arm ids or labels read as Not run (cut) with figure "--not-run"
#
# Row treatment (DEC-0393, DEC-0417):
#   not decided, listed  rows of a smoke batch (manifest smoke: true), rows whose batch has
#                        no manifest, rows of an arm the suite does not run (absent or
#                        unknown), rows on a task type outside the arm's task_types
#                        (applicability refusals; not counted in the excluded share)
#   excluded pairwise    status in rules.exclusion.statuses plus transport_error and
#                        infrastructure_error (DEC-0417), degraded: true (with
#                        --exclude-degraded true), and a scoring status whose primary is
#                        null (ungraded); the task-trial cell leaves BOTH arms of every
#                        comparison it is in; a cell holding a valid row (a rerun) is valid
#   cap_failure          0 on every applicable primary (pass rate 0, every defect missed)
#   completed, agent_error  score what the row holds (hidden_test_pass_rate; defects)
#   The sensitivity figure repeats the comparison with cap_failure excluded pairwise
#   instead of scored 0; no decision reads it.
#
# Statistics (pre-registered in the suite's rules block; formulas in the Method section):
#   pass rate unit  the task: per task, the mean over its valid trials, arm minus a1_full
#   catch-rate unit the defect: per review-catch task and defect dK, the share of the
#                   arm's valid trials that caught it, arm minus a1_full; per-defect ids
#                   come from the row's `defects_missed` (or `recall.missed`) list of dK
#                   ids when present, else each defect of the task takes the row's
#                   defect_catch_rate (aggregate rows); the task-level figure is also
#                   reported (rules.bootstrap.also_report) and decides nothing
#   interval        percentile bootstrap of the mean paired difference: `resamples`
#                   resamples with replacement, linear interpolation between order
#                   statistics, [lo, hi] = the (1-level)/2 and 1-(1-level)/2 quantiles
#   d               the mean of the paired differences (not the bootstrap mean)
#   c, w            cost and wall-clock delta in percent against a1_full,
#                   (mean_arm − mean_a1) / mean_a1 × 100, over the per-task means of the
#                   cells the primaries paired
#   MDE             (z(1−(1−level)/2) + z(0.90)) × sd(paired diffs) / sqrt(n): the smallest
#                   true mean difference a paired test at the report level detects with 0.90
#                   power at the available n; n < 2 → n/a
#   comparisons     every predicate compares values rounded to 9 decimals, so a planted
#                   −0.03 reads −0.03 and not −0.030000000000000027
#
# Decision per arm (rules.predicates, first match, DEC-0416, with DEC-0393's guard first):
#   the degradation guard (excluded share > rules.exclusion.inconclusive_above_share →
#   inconclusive, labelled Inconclusive-by-degradation, whatever the interval) →
#   investigate → keep → inconclusive (d < -0.03 or no valid pair) → remove → simplify. Then: an arm named by --cuts / --not-run reads
#   Not run (cut) or Inconclusive-by-power with the lead's figure; an arm whose MDE on an
#   applicable primary exceeds rules.mde_cut and whose predicate outcome is remove or
#   simplify reads Inconclusive-by-power with the figure (a null result the sample could
#   not have detected); A8 (absent: true) reads component-absent with the suite evidence.
#
# Exit codes:
#   0  report written
#   1  --partial and no decidable comparison (the report is still written)
#   2  usage error, unreadable input, unknown schema major, provenance conflict
#
# Tested by evals/tests/ablation-report.bats (planted rows generated by
# evals/tests/fixtures/ablation-report/gen-fixtures.py).
# =============================================================================
import argparse
import json
import math
import os
import random
import re
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys

VERSION = "1.0.0"
REPORT_SCHEMA = 1
ROW_SCHEMA_MAJOR = 1
MANIFEST_SCHEMA_MAJOR = 1
CONTROL = "a1_full"
BARE = "a0_bare"
SENSITIVITY_ARM = "a4_no_gates"
BUILD_TYPES = ("feature-build", "bug-fix", "refactor")
REVIEW = "review-catch"
PASS = "hidden_test_pass_rate"
CATCH = "defect_catch_rate"
DEC0417_EXCLUDED = ("transport_error", "infrastructure_error")
SCORING = ("completed", "agent_error", "cap_failure")
POWER = 0.90
DISPLAY = {"investigate": "Investigate", "keep": "Keep", "inconclusive": "Inconclusive",
           "remove": "Remove", "simplify": "Simplify", "not_run_cut": "Not run (cut)",
           "inconclusive_by_power": "Inconclusive-by-power", "component_absent": "component-absent",
           "no_rows": "no rows"}
PARTIAL_LINE = "PARTIAL — rows so far, no decision is final"
SENS_LABEL = "sensitivity (cap failures excluded) — no decision uses this"


class Fail(Exception):
    pass


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- small helpers
def r9(x):
    return None if x is None else round(x, 9)


def mean(xs):
    xs = [x for x in xs if x is not None]
    return sum(xs) / len(xs) if xs else None


def f3(x):
    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:+.3f}" if x != 0 else "0.000"


def u3(x):
    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:.3f}"


def pct(x):
    return "n/a" if x is None else f"{x:+.1f} %"


def j6(x):
    return None if x is None else round(x, 6)


def schema_major(v):
    if isinstance(v, bool):
        return None
    if isinstance(v, int):
        return v
    if isinstance(v, float) and v.is_integer():
        return int(v)
    if isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch(r"\d+(\.\d+)*", v):
        return int(v.split(".")[0])
    return None


def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
    n = len(sorted_xs)
    if n == 0:
        return None
    pos = q * (n - 1)
    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
    frac = pos - lo
    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac


def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
    if not diffs:
        return None, None
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = len(diffs)
    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)


def mde(diffs, level):
    if len(diffs) < 2:
        return None
    nd = statistics.NormalDist()
    z = nd.inv_cdf(1.0 - (1.0 - level) / 2.0) + nd.inv_cdf(POWER)
    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))


def collapse(run_ids):
    """batch-arm-task-t1, -t2, -t3 → batch-arm-task-t1…t3 (non-contiguous: t1,t3)."""
    groups, other = {}, []
    for rid in run_ids:
        m = re.fullmatch(r"(.*-t)(\d+)", rid)
        if m:
            groups.setdefault(m.group(1), []).append(int(m.group(2)))
        else:
            other.append(rid)
    out = []
    for prefix in sorted(groups):
        ns = sorted(set(groups[prefix]))
        if len(ns) == 1:
            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}")
        elif len(ns) >= 3 and ns == list(range(ns[0], ns[-1] + 1)):
            out.append(f"{prefix}{ns[0]}…t{ns[-1]}")
        else:
            out.append(prefix + ",t".join(str(n) for n in ns))
    return out + sorted(other)


def md_cell(s):
    return str(s).replace("|", "\\|").replace("\n", " ")


# --------------------------------------------------------------------------- inputs
def load_suite(path):
    try:
        with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
            raw = fh.read()
    except OSError as e:
        raise Fail(f"cannot read suite {path}: {e.strerror}")
    try:
        suite = json.loads(raw)
    except ValueError:
        try:
            out = subprocess.run(["yq", "-o=json", ".", path], check=True, capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
            suite = json.loads(out)
        except (OSError, subprocess.CalledProcessError, ValueError):
            raise Fail(f"cannot parse suite {path} (YAML needs yq v4 on PATH)")
    if not isinstance(suite, dict) or not isinstance(suite.get("arms"), list) or not isinstance(suite.get("rules"), dict):

def percentile(sorted_xs, q):
    """Linear interpolation between order statistics (numpy's default 'linear')."""
    n = len(sorted_xs)
    if n == 0:
        return None
    pos = q * (n - 1)
    lo = int(math.floor(pos))
    hi = min(lo + 1, n - 1)
    frac = pos - lo
    return sorted_xs[lo] + (sorted_xs[hi] - sorted_xs[lo]) * frac


def bootstrap(diffs, resamples, level, seed):
    if not diffs:
        return None, None
    rng = random.Random(seed)
    n = len(diffs)
    means = sorted(sum(rng.choices(diffs, k=n)) / n for _ in range(resamples))
    a = (1.0 - level) / 2.0
    return percentile(means, a), percentile(means, 1.0 - a)


def mde(diffs, level):

    return z * statistics.stdev(diffs) / math.sqrt(len(diffs))

def write_out(path, text):
    if os.path.islink(path):
        raise Fail(f"refusing to write through the symlink {path}")
    parent = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(path))
    if not os.path.isdir(parent):
        raise Fail(f"the directory of {path} does not exist")
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        fh.write(text)


class Parser(argparse.ArgumentParser):
    def error(self, message):
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {message}\n")
        sys.exit(2)


def main(argv):
    ap = Parser(prog="ablation-report.py", description="cycle-130 ablation report (see the header)")
    ap.add_argument("--runs", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--manifests", action="append", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--suite", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--out", required=True)
    ap.add_argument("--json", dest="json_out")
    ap.add_argument("--seed", type=int, default=20261015)
    ap.add_argument("--resamples", type=int)
    ap.add_argument("--level", type=float)
    ap.add_argument("--exclude-degraded", choices=("true", "false"), default="true")
    ap.add_argument("--partial", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--cuts")
    ap.add_argument("--not-run")
    args = ap.parse_args(argv)
    args.exclude_degraded = args.exclude_degraded == "true"
    try:
        text, data, decidable = build(args)
        write_out(args.out, text)
        if args.json_out:
            write_out(args.json_out, json.dumps(data, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
    except Fail as e:
        sys.stderr.write(f"ablation-report.py: {e}\n")
        return 2
    if args.partial and not decidable:
        sys.stderr.write("ablation-report.py: --partial: no comparison has a valid pair yet (report written)\n")
        return 1
    print(f"ablation-report.py: wrote {args.out}" + (f" and {args.json_out}" if args.json_out else ""))
    return 0
